errors.text_span: 依据某种基于深加工语料库的量化评分体系进行排序
errors.evidence: This part of the description introduces information ('based on a quantitative scoring system from a deep-processing corpus') that is not present in the figure itself, but likely comes from the title of the paper where the figure was published. A description should only contain information explicitly visible in the chart image.

errors.text_span: 按难度值从高到低自上而下排列
errors.evidence: The title of the chart is 'Top 10 Easiest Poems', which means a lower score indicates an easier poem. The chart is sorted with the highest scores at the top and lowest scores at the bottom. Therefore, the sorting is from least easy to most easy, not 'from high difficulty to low difficulty'.
